'''Xa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], she sold specialized gear for [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] in the Combat Training section of [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xa first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a level 50 Battlemaster PVP Gear vendor.
